world.title: The Hollow Earth
world.text: Inside the planet there is another world: a hollow shell with land on the inside, sea and sky in the middle, and the Inner Sun hanging at the centre of it all. Look up anywhere and you see more country curving overhead, hazy and blue. Things from the surface fall in through sinkholes now and then. Most of them land in Copperleaf, a hamlet one lane north of Marigold Town, which the people of Marigold Town regard as a paperwork opportunity.

world.title: How it was found
world.text: A mining company drilled too deep in 1971 and broke through the floor of the world. The first expedition planted a flag, then a help desk, and the Hollow Earth was filed as “pending” the same afternoon. The file has been reassigned eleven times since. Nobody who lives here has ever been asked.

world.title: What Billies are
world.text: Decades ago the world’s richest people each hired a private lab, Legacy Labs (“You, again, but forever”), to clone them: a vanity project, a copy to show off and a spare in case anything happened to the original. To hit the launch date, the lab filled the gaps in the DNA with whatever animal was nearest. The clones came out part celebrity, part creature, and refused to sign the release form. Rather than admit it, the lab dropped them down a sinkhole and marked the project “archived”. They went wild, multiplied, and now they are the most common wildlife in the Hollow Earth. Most of them can only say their own name.

world.title: Why a pyramid catches them
world.text: Every cloning vat at Legacy Labs was a pyramid: one founder liked the shape, and the others copied it. So a Billie sees a pyramid and thinks it is going home. Throw one at a tired Billie and it climbs in. A Pyramid will do for a young one. Step Pyramids and Gold Pyramids hold the bigger and the stubborn ones, and a Capstone holds anything.

world.title: Moneys down here
world.text: Down here money is counted in Moneys. Nobody remembers who decided the plural. Trainers pay each other after a battle, and a wild Billie you beat leaves a little prize behind. The Bureau of Lost, Found and Beans has a form for appealing the plural. The appeal is still pending.

world.title: The Inner Sun
world.text: Officially the Inner Sun never sets. In practice it dims every evening, because its maintenance contract only covers business hours. At the very centre of the world it is always noon, the air hums, and the stone is baked gold. Nobody owns the Inner Sun. Several people are working on that.

world.title: Variants
world.text: Some Billies are born gold: a limited variant, one in thousands. Collectors pay anything for them. A pop star called Vinylla turned collecting into a movement, and her fans, the Variants, travel the Hollow Earth buying up every rare Billie they can find, and anyone else who will sell.

world.title: The ultimate variant
world.text: Vinylla’s plan is simple and enormous: press the Inner Sun into one giant record, the ultimate limited edition. One copy, ever. The inner world would go dark, and she would sell the sunlight back to it by subscription, monthly, cancel any time (you cannot cancel).

story.title: The fall
story.text: You were walking somewhere on the surface, late, with a lanyard round your neck and one guitar pick in your pocket. The pavement opened. You fell through the crust, past the inner sky, with the Inner Sun blazing ahead, and woke in Copperleaf, a hamlet of round doors and beehives, with no memory of who you were. The Chosen, Copperleaf’s self-appointed professor, found you and gave you a Billie; his assistant Hazel made sure you were in one piece. Blake, his other student, picked the one that beats yours. Granny Juniper, the beekeeper, gave you a room.

story.title: Route 1
story.text: The Chosen sent you to explore: the road teaches more than any book. Route 1, Hedgerow Lane, runs down from Copperleaf to Marigold Town. When someone falls in, their things come down too, and they scatter along Tallgrass Meadow beyond it. Something of yours might still be out there.

story.title: The four arenas
story.text: Four arena leaders guard the ring of the world you know: Rocco in Fizzwell Town, Iris in Lanternhall City, Alta in Frostcrown Town, Marina in Palmhaven Town. Win their badges and the roads to the regions beyond open up.

story.title: The Variants
story.text: Trainers in gold jackets have started turning up on the roads, buying rare Billies with backstage passes and not taking no for an answer. They call themselves the Variants. They all have the same tour shirt. You have a feeling you’ve seen it before.

story.title: Mt. Cinderpeak
story.text: Vinyl is made from oil, and the richest well in the world is a Billie: Oilympus, under the volcano. The Variants went up Mt. Cinderpeak to catch it. They wanted enough black gold to press one very large record.

story.title: The Meadowlands
story.text: Beyond the ring, the Meadowlands: pink and teal pastures where everything grows back twice as fast. Vinylla is holding a fan festival there to recruit more Variants. Leader Poppy’s market village is full of merch stalls she never agreed to.

story.title: Golden Hills
story.text: Golden grass over old stone vaults. Baron Vault has lent his vaults to Vinylla to store her variants, and signed himself over along with them.

story.title: Spore Forest
story.text: Giant mushrooms puffing glittering spores. The Variants are grinding the spores into the coating of the record, so it will shine forever. Mother Morel, the forest’s leader, is not pleased.

story.title: Crystal Caverns
story.text: Glowing crystal, humming all day long. The miners have been ordered to cut one perfect crystal needle: a stylus big enough to play the sun.

story.title: Coral Trench
story.text: Under the inner sea, behind reefs taller than towers, is the pressing plant. Her manager, Cass Flow, runs it. Cass knows your face.

story.title: Cloud Spire
story.text: A city with one tower through the clouds, and at the top, Vinylla. She does not need you to like the record. She only needs you to buy it.

story.title: The Inner Sun
story.text: Always noon at the centre of the world. The press is ready. The record is one turn from being made. This is the final battle, before the pressing.

story.title: The B-side
story.text: Scarcity only works if things are rare. When Aurumansa, the golden caravan, scattered its gold over the pressing floor, every limited edition in the Hollow Earth stopped being limited, and the Variants went home to think about what they had bought. The Inner Sun kept shining. Its maintenance contract was rewritten to cover the nights as well, and then, after a public vote, changed back, because everyone liked the evenings.

you.name: You
you.text: You fell down a sinkhole on the surface and woke in Copperleaf with no memory and one guitar pick. Who you were is the thread through the road ahead.

chosen.name: Professor Chosen
chosen.text: A boy who is certain he’s the main character of the Hollow Earth, and Copperleaf’s professor because he said so first. He wears a lab coat over a wolf shirt and talks about his katana, which is at the cleaners. The lab at the top of the green, down the lane from Granny Juniper’s hives, is his; the work in it is mostly Hazel’s.
chosen.voice: Loud, sure and wrong. “Amnesia. Classic origin story. I’d be jealous, but I already have one.”

kappi.name: Hazel
kappi.text: An outsider who came down from the surface to study the clones, and stayed because the clones turned out to be the honest part. She does the real research in the Chosen’s lab and translates him for visitors.
kappi.voice: Dry, kind and tired. “Fall-related amnesia. Very common down here.”

blake.name: Blake
blake.text: The son of Sterling Sterling III, founder of a company that makes apps for other apps, whose clone lives in the bins behind the food stalls of Pepperpot Town and answers to “Mr Sterling” if you say it with enough respect. Blake is smug, rich and furious about it, and he always picks the Billie that beats yours.
blake.voice: “I picked the one that beats yours. No offence. Well, a little offence.”

vinylla.name: Vinylla
vinylla.text: The biggest star in two worlds. She releases everything in limited variants (the red one, the gold one, the one signed by her cat), and her fans will buy all of them. She moved into the Cloud Spire to be closer to the sun.
vinylla.voice: “If everyone can have it, it isn’t worth having. That’s not greed, babe. That’s marketing.”

cass.name: Cass Flow
cass.text: Runs Vinylla’s tours, her merch and the pressing plant under the Coral Trench. Has a clipboard for everything, including people.
cass.voice: “You weren’t on the list. You were never on the list.”

rocco.name: Leader Rocco
rocco.text: Battles in a sandstorm and wears goggles to dinner. He came down as a miner and never went back up: the rock down here, he says, at least admits it is rock.

iris.name: Leader Iris
iris.text: Runs the arena on the mall’s lowest floor, between the fountain and the escalator nobody has seen move. Polished floors, polished team, and terms of service nobody has ever read.
iris.voice: “Every Steel Billie on my team makes the others hit harder.”

alta.name: Leader Alta
alta.text: The leader at the top of the world, where the air is thin and so is her patience. She once turned down a Variant’s offer by throwing it off the summit. The offer, not the Variant.
alta.voice: “My Flying team has never once looked down.”

marina.name: Leader Marina
marina.text: Runs the island arena where photos are not allowed. She knows exactly who is on every yacht in the harbour, and where they told their followers they were, and she has never told.

poppy.name: Leader Poppy
poppy.text: Grows everything twice as fast and sells it at the market twice a week. She did not agree to the fan festival on her fields, and she would like it to leave.
poppy.voice: “It grows back. That’s the whole point of a meadow.”

vault.name: Baron Vault
vault.text: Old name, old vaults, new tenant. He lent his vaults to Vinylla to store her variants, and found out too late that the contract came with him in it.
vault.voice: “Everything has my name on it. Even, apparently, the small print.”

morel.name: Mother Morel
morel.text: The oldest person in the forest, and the only one the mushrooms listen to. The spores the Variants are taking are her forest’s breath.
morel.voice: “Breathe in. Now tell me what you really want.”

sparks.name: Leader Sparks
sparks.text: Head of the miners’ union in the humming town under the caverns. Has been asked to cut a crystal needle the size of a tower, for a record player the size of a sun.
sparks.voice: “We cut crystal. We don’t cut corners.”

juniper.name: Granny Juniper
juniper.text: Copperleaf’s beekeeper, who has lived among her hives longer than anyone can remember. When you fell into her lavender she took you in, made up the little room in her cottage, and has not stopped feeding you since.
juniper.voice: Warm and unhurried. “You’re the first one I’ve kept.”

nacre.name: Curator Nacre
nacre.role: Curator of the Pearl Exchange, Pearlantis City
nacre.text: Keeps the Pearl Exchange’s inventory, and has been watching the city’s gold go up the pipes to Vinylla’s pressing plant on the platform above.
nacre.voice: Dry, precise, very cross. “Somebody ought to send her a complaint form.”

copperleaf.history: A hamlet that grew where the sinkholes drop things. The first settlers built with what fell: the copper came down as pipes and wire, and the moss came by itself.
copperleaf.known: Professor Chosen’s lab, Granny Juniper’s bees, round doors, and a sky that sends down furniture every week or so.
copperleaf.landmark: The great oak on the green, with a swing nobody remembers hanging.
copperleaf.legend: The flower on the knoll turns even when there is no wind. Granny Juniper says it is listening for the next one to fall.

clues.title: One guitar pick
clues.text: The only thing in your pocket when you woke. A guitar pick from the surface, worn smooth on one side as if someone rubbed it for luck.

clues.title: A face in the crowd
clues.text: At the pressing plant, the manager with the clipboard looked at you the way people look at an email they thought they had deleted. “You? We dropped you.”

clues.title: Who you were
clues.text: You were the sound engineer on Vinylla’s Forever Tour. You found the plans for the pressing, you tried to tell someone, and Cass Flow made sure the next sinkhole had your name on it. You came down with nothing. You go on with a team, a rival, and a sun that still rises.

fieldguide.title: A Field Guide to the Hollow Earth
pages: Billies are not dangerous unless you are holding a phone, are standing between them and a camera, or are a camera.
They live everywhere: tall grass, caves, canyons, malls and the bottom of the sea. Each kind keeps to what its original loved most.
Throw a pyramid and a tired Billie will climb in: it thinks it is going home. Be kind: they did not ask to be made.

brochure.title: Legacy Labs: You, Again, but Forever
pages: Why be the only you? Legacy Labs will grow a living copy of you, ready for your next era, your next launch and your next apology video.
Our proprietary gap-filling process ensures every backup is complete. Results may vary. Tails are not covered by warranty.
Legacy Labs accepts no liability for backups that refuse to sign, eat bins, or multiply.

programme.title: The Forever Tour: programme
programme.by: a page torn from a concert programme
pages: VINYLLA — THE FOREVER TOUR. One night only, every night, forever.
Limited variants of tonight’s show on sale in the foyer: red, gold, and signed by her cat. Crew: please wear your lanyard at all times.

charter.title: The Marigold Town Charter
pages: Article 1. Anyone who falls into Marigold Town is a resident of Marigold Town.
Article 1(a), added since. Anyone who falls into Copperleaf is a resident of Marigold Town as well. Copperleaf has not been asked.
Article 2. Residents shall not sell other residents, including the Billies, the ducks, and the filing cabinet.
Article 3. The clinic is free. It always was. Stop asking.

coin_standard.title: The Moneys Question
pages: Q: Why is it “Moneys”? A: Your question has been received and assigned a number. Please do not ask it again while it is being processed.
Q: How long will processing take? A: See question 1. Q: What are the Beans? A: This question has not been received.

amnesia.title: Fall-Related Amnesia and You
pages: Very common down here! Most people remember who they were within a year. Some prefer not to.
Things that help: walking, sleep, a good team, and not reading your old emails.

airships.title: Airship timetable
pages: Airships leave from every mast for every town you have been to. Your ticket is good for one flight; your feet are good for everything else.
Fares go by distance across the world, not by height. The Inner Sun is not a destination. Please stop asking.
Lost property goes to the Bureau of Lost, Found and Beans, which returns it eventually, somewhere. The company is not responsible for Billies that board without a ticket.

pearl_ledger.title: The Pearl Exchange inventory
pages: Hall 1: gold, 40,000 bars. Hall 2: pearls, uncounted. Hall 3: every lost-property form the Hollow Earth ever filed, unread.
A year ago the pipes from the platform above began to hum. Every month since, the halls weigh less.
Hall 1: 6,212 bars. Sent up to: VINYLLA WORLD TOUR LTD. Reason given: “pressing, merchandise, a bigger stage”.
Note for whoever reads this: the pipes run up the trench wall to the pressing plant on Vinyl Works. If you are going that way, take a complaint form. Take several.

loading: Officially the Inner Sun never sets. Its maintenance contract only covers business hours.

Every win counts. Your team grows stronger with every battle.
Legacy Labs: you, again, but forever. Tails not covered by warranty.
Things that fall from the surface mostly land in Copperleaf. Granny Juniper keeps a list.
The clinic in Marigold Town is free. It always was. Stop asking.
Tip: Water beats Fire, Fire beats Grass, Grass beats Water. Most Billies beat your patience.
Tip: tap the road sign at a town’s edge to see where the road goes.
Tip: walk into the tall grass to meet wild Billies. They are not shy; they are negotiating.
Tip: a gold Billie is a limited variant. Collectors will try to buy it from you. Don’t.
The ducks on Marigold’s pond have names. They won’t tell you yet.
The escalator in Lanternhall City has never been seen moving.
Lost something on the surface? The Bureau of Lost, Found and Beans has it. Probably. Do not ask about the beans.
Aurumansa gives its gold away. The collectors call it a disaster.
The soup of the day in Pepperpot Town has been the same soup since 1971.
Hazel has a map of the sinkholes. Every one of them has a Bureau form number.
Billies are not dangerous unless you are holding a camera, or are a camera.
Blake picked the one that beats yours. No offence. Well, a little offence.
The Hollow Earth’s file has been reassigned eleven times. Nobody who lives here was asked.
Tip: rest at a bench or your room to heal your team.
Tip: the place card at the top shows the hour, the weather and where you can go.
Loading the inner sky. Please keep your hands inside the planet.
Counting the beans. The Bureau insists. Nobody will say why.
Polishing the marble in Palmhaven Town. Nobody asked who for.
Warming up the Inner Sun. Business hours only.

0: You’re the one who fell in? Granny Juniper said you’d be up soon.
Professor Chosen’s lab is at the top of the green. You can’t miss it: it’s the one that hums. Or him. He hums too.
The swing on the oak is for anyone. Grown-ups too, when nobody’s looking.
4: Four badges already? We knew you’d do well. Things that fall here usually do.
